newsitem.title: USA: Alaska Apollo funds Kentucky drilling.
newsitem.headline: Alaska Apollo funds Kentucky drilling.

text.p: Daugherty Petroleum Inc on Wednesday said it received a loan from a unit of Enron Corp for developmental drilling in the Gausdale Gas Field, Knox County, Kentucky.

The company earmarked most of the funds, provided by Enron Capital and Trade Resources, for a three-well drilling program and the purchase of one proved, developed, non-producing property, the Alaska Apollo Resources Inc subsidiary said.
The wells are to be drilled on a 14,000-acre lease owned by Equitable Resources Inc in the Gausdale field, with some 100 additional drilling locations.
Daugherty Petroleum has a 67 percent working interest and a 57.2 percent net revenue interest in the three development wells, the company said.
It will expand its natural gas-gathering system to transport gas developed from these wellsy added.
